question: Should OpenClaw accept this restart-specific durable SQLite audit table that stores redacted restart source/session/preflight metadata with fixed 512-row retention?
rationale: The remaining choice is not a mechanical code defect: it changes the local persistent metadata boundary and writes near restart availability paths, so maintainers need to own the privacy, retention, storage, and product-shape decision.

options.title: Accept Restart Audit Storage
options.body: Merge after rebase if maintainers explicitly accept the table, metadata fields, redaction, retention, and restart-path write placement.

options.title: Narrow Persisted Metadata
options.body: Require a smaller stored field set or stricter redaction contract before merge if the privacy boundary is broader than desired.

options.title: Defer To Audit Ledger
options.body: Pause or close this PR if restart events should wait for the broader metadata-only audit-ledger direction instead of landing as a standalone producer now.

recommendation.title: Accept Restart Audit Storage
recommendation.body: Merge after rebase if maintainers explicitly accept the table, metadata fields, redaction, retention, and restart-path write placement.

likelyOwner.reason: This decision sits at the restart/state/audit product boundary, and steipete has the strongest history signal across the related restart and audit-ledger surfaces.
